submission.name: Fieldnote Voice
submission.tagline: Turn campus garden logs into quick, spoken care reminders.
submission.inspiration: Campus garden volunteers share plots and rotate watering, but notes about what was planted or tended can be scattered across notebooks. We wanted a lightweight way for student garden teams to turn those observations into an easier handoff.
submission.what_it_does: Users can upload a CSV of garden observations and ask questions about recent watering or plant care; Gemini drafts a short summary, and ElevenLabs can read it aloud. The end-to-end demo works inconsistently because date and plant names in the sample files are not always parsed correctly.
submission.how_we_built_it: We made a small HTML and JavaScript interface for CSV upload and audio playback, backed by Python and Flask for parsing and API calls. Gemini generates care summaries from the parsed rows, while ElevenLabs converts the response into speech.
submission.challenges_we_ran_into: CSV columns and handwritten-style abbreviations are easy to misread, which can make a reminder incomplete. We also had trouble keeping the upload, summary, and audio steps reliable in one session.
submission.accomplishments: We built a working prototype that can turn a garden log into a short spoken summary. It gave us a useful starting point for making volunteer handoffs easier to scan.
submission.what_we_learned: We learned to validate the input data before asking Gemini to summarize it, and got practical experience connecting Flask with two APIs.
submission.whats_next: We would add a review step for uncertain entries and support shared plot notes across volunteers. We would also test more CSV layouts and make reminders configurable by plant and schedule.
